# Player Died

Source: [4818](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4818); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4818-n1"></a>

- Player Died has Event Player equal Victim; Attacker is final-blow dealer (same on suicide). Context exposes received damage, critical hit, ability and incoming direction.
